charter.system_heading: SYSTEM: CIBERSOC — Cybernetic and Demarchic Governance Model (Mechanism Design & Input-Output Simulator)
charter.reference_1: Statistical sampling theory and classical sortition applied to federated public administration (elimination of electoral oligarchy)
charter.reference_2: W. Paul Cockshott & Allin Cottrell — Towards a New Socialism (sparse input-output planning, labour-time accounting and short-run Harmony)
charter.axioms_heading: SEVEN STRUCTURAL AND ANALYTICAL AXIOMS OF CIBERSOC:
charter.axiom_1_title: Pure Statistical Demarchy and Abolition of Elections
charter.axiom_1_body: CIBERSOC abolishes 100% of direct and indirect elections, political parties and career politicians, filling every seat via auditable stratified cryptographic sortition (Commit-Reveal + Hamilton) with compulsory exclusion from the subsequent cycle.
charter.axiom_2_body: CIBERSOC models a permanent institutional equilibrium rather than a temporary transitional stage, dedicated to continuous allocative optimisation under a headless collegial State.
charter.axiom_3_title: Four-Tier Escalated Council Mesh & Logistical Secretary-General
charter.axiom_3_body: Interlinked Sectoral, Municipal, State and Federal Councils abolish President, Prime Minister, Governor and Mayor offices, restricting each Secretary-General to logistical agenda and minutes coordination with unitary vote weight and zero veto or decree power.
charter.axiom_4_title: Exclusive Civilian Control of the Ministry of Defence
charter.axiom_4_body: The Federal Ministry of Defence is staffed exclusively by sorted civilians; high-ranking generals answer directly to the sorted civilian minister under a Collegiate Civilian Multi-Sig gate.
charter.axiom_5_title: CEO Abolition and Strictly Equal 1/N Enterprise Surplus Sharing
charter.axiom_5_body: Productive enterprises operate under usufruct bitmask [1,0,0,0], extinguish all CEO/C-Suite positions and distribute 100% of net operating surplus equally (1/N) across active workers via exact integer-day rational arithmetic with zero corporate retention.
charter.axiom_6_body: Sorted councillors receive a state stipend matching their prior civilian pay indexed to official inflation, followed by guaranteed job reinstatement and a minimum 180-day dismissal lock.
charter.axiom_7_title: Closed Macroeconomic Plebiscites & Refutation of Electoral Coercion
charter.axiom_7_body: Direct popular voting occurs solely on concrete macroeconomic budget flows (e.g. +5% Education vs +5% Health) binding upon all Councils, replacing causally null candidate elections with positive marginal voter impact.

simulation.viewer.title: CIBERSOC — SEEM Engine · Comparative National Simulation
simulation.viewer.ctrl_hint: Drag: orbit · Scroll / +−: zoom · Right button / Ctrl+arrows: pan
simulation.viewer.legend_towers_text: Each vertical tower represents one federated state. Its height and colour encode the state's Human Development Index (HDI): tall and green indicates high HDI (≥ 0.80), medium amber indicates moderate HDI (~0.70), and short reddish indicates lower HDI (≤ 0.55). Click any tower to open its deep state inspector.
simulation.viewer.legend_rings_title: Rings on the ground = Demographic Weight (Macro Population)
simulation.viewer.legend_rings_text: The concentric ring around each tower represents the total demographic scale (census population) of that territory: a larger ring diameter denotes more inhabitants (e.g. São Paulo ~45M vs Amazonas ~4.2M). The rings are geometrically fixed to the ground plane and serve as macro territory markers.
simulation.viewer.legend_arcs_text: Curved trajectories linking federated capitals represent cooperative supply-chain and resource-equalisation flows across Brazil's macro-regions over the continental silhouette.
simulation.viewer.legend_particles_title: Orbiting particles = Active Citizens in Sortition (Demarchic Assemblies)
simulation.viewer.legend_particles_text: The swirling points orbiting each state represent individual active citizens participating in demarchic sortition assemblies and collegiate councils. Their orbital dynamics reflect civic mobilization, while their diverse colour palette reflects demographic representation. Unlike the static rings, particles symbolize living civic engagement.
simulation.viewer.gl_population: Population: The total census number of human residents living in a state (represented by the ground ring diameter) or across the entire nation (shown in the HUD panel).
simulation.viewer.gl_citizens: Citizens: Adult residents who have passed civic registration and are eligible for sortition into collegiate councils. Every demarchic cycle draws citizens into governance with strict rotation and post-mandate quarantine (zero career politicians).
simulation.viewer.gl_hdi: HDI (Human Development Index): A synthetic composite metric from 0.000 to 1.000 combining public health, universal education, and social dividend. Higher values reflect superior well-being.
simulation.viewer.gl_gini: GINI Coefficient: Measures income inequality on a scale from 0.000 (absolute equality, where every worker receives their exact 1/N surplus) to 1.000 (total oligarchical monopoly). Lower values indicate greater social equality.
simulation.viewer.gl_employment: Employment: The percentage of the active demarchic workforce engaged in productive, educational, ecological, and administrative endeavours.
